The '''Matriarch's Summit''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] in the [[Tythos Ridge]] on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]]' settlement of [[Kalikori village]] was built at the mountain's base, and [[Kolovish]]&mdash;the pilgrims' original [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]], or leader&mdash;resided in a retreat at the top of the mountain. Pilgrims and even [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] participated in a ritual called "The Thousand Steps", where they ascended the mountain and lit the four signal fires along the path. If they made it to the top, they were granted an audience with Kolovish. However, the path was fraught with the native [[Flesh Raider]]s, who kept [[Cthon/Legends|Cthon]] as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and weapons.<ref name="The Thousand Steps">{{TORcite|type=general|The Thousand Steps|Tython}}</ref>
